crossRefs.note: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

parallels.note: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”
They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

translations.web: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

translations.kjv: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
